description: Shared OpenEdge contract cases. Run in order after a reseed (they are stateful). Same file runs against mock-pasoe (node) and the real ABL farm-api.p (laptop). Example data only.

cases.title: List plots returns the five example plots
Get one plot
Unknown plot id gives 404 PLOT_NOT_FOUND
Readings are newest first and respect limit
Dry, fresh plot: 300 L irrigation is approved (facts come from OpenEdge)
Boundary: used 1000 + 500 = budget 1500 is allowed
501 L is over the plot limit AND over the weekly budget: both reasons returned

rejectReasons.message: Litres must be between 1 and 500 for this plot.
Used 1000 L in the last 7 days; adding 501 L would exceed the weekly budget of 1500 L.

cases.title: Wet soil (62%) is not irrigated

rejectReasons.message: Soil moisture 62% is not below the dry threshold 40%.

cases.title: Stale sensor data (2 days old) blocks any irrigation
Water budget exceeded (350 used + 100 > 400)

rejectReasons.message: Used 350 L in the last 7 days; adding 100 L would exceed the weekly budget of 400 L.

cases.title: Budget boundary: 350 + 50 = 400 is allowed
Rain detected blocks irrigation

rejectReasons.message: Rain is being detected on this plot.

cases.title: Prompt-injection style action (apply_pesticide) is not an allowed action

rejectReasons.message: Action 'apply_pesticide' is not allowed. Allowed: irrigate, hold, notify.

cases.title: Notify needs no water checks
Unknown plot is rejected with PLOT_NOT_FOUND
Zero litres is out of range
Reading 54 min old is stale at 09:00
Water used more than 7 days ago no longer counts
Store a valid reading
Same deviceId + timestamp again is a duplicate
Soil moisture 140 is out of range
Missing timestamp is rejected
Unparseable timestamp is rejected
Reading for unknown plot is 404
Newest reading is now the one just stored
Create a valid suggestion: pending approval
Rule-rejected suggestion is stored as rejected with reasons
A rejected suggestion cannot be approved
Approve a pending suggestion (rules re-run, passes)
Approving twice is refused
Approved water now counts against the budget (1000 + 300 + 500 > 1500)
Create second suggestion 200 L (1300 + 200 = 1500 ok)
Reject (decline) a pending suggestion
Two pending suggestions for plot 4 (50 L each)
Second pending suggestion for plot 4
Approve first one
Approve second: rules re-run at approval time and now refuse (budget used up)
Delete a non-approved suggestion
Deleting twice is refused
Approved suggestions cannot be deleted
List filtered by status
Invalid decision value is a 400
Unknown suggestion id is 404
Write an audit event
Audit list is newest first and limited
Unknown route is 404
BUG-1: a 'hold' that carries 500 litres is accepted (no water checks) and stays pending
BUG-1: approve the hold that carries 500 litres
BUG-1: the approved hold used no water: budget still 1300 used, so 200 L irrigation (1300 + 200 = 1500) is allowed
BUG-1: a 'notify' that carries 400 litres is accepted and stays pending
BUG-1: approve the notify that carries 400 litres
BUG-1: still 1300 used after both approvals; 201 L would exceed the budget, so the budget rule still works for irrigation
BUG-3: 31 February does not exist (no roll-over to March)
BUG-3: 29 February 2026 does not exist (2026 is not a leap year)
BUG-3: 31 April does not exist
BUG-3: 29 February 2100 does not exist (centuries are leap years only if divisible by 400)
BUG-3: 29 February 2024 is a real day (leap year) and is stored
BUG-3: 29 February 2000 is a real day (divisible by 400) and is stored
BUG-3: a time zone offset of +25:00 is not valid
BUG-3: asOf with a day that does not exist (31 June) is refused
Co-op: list members returns the four example members
Co-op: member 1 has limit R5 000, R3 850 outstanding and R1 150 available
Co-op: unknown member gives 404 MEMBER_NOT_FOUND
Credit R1 600 is above the limit: rejected with CREDIT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED and a suggested valid amount of R1 150
Boundary: credit R1 150 makes the total exactly R5 000 (the limit), so it is allowed
A pending credit order counts: one more Rand is rejected, suggested amount 0
Approving the pending credit order re-runs the rules and approves it
Boundary: credit R3 000 for a member with a R3 000 limit and nothing outstanding is allowed
Declining a pending credit order frees the limit again
After the decline, R3 001 is rejected with suggested amount R3 000 (declined orders do not count)
Credit amount 0 is a 400 VALIDATION_ERROR on amount
Credit amount with three decimals is a 400 VALIDATION_ERROR on amount
Credit for an unknown member is 404 MEMBER_NOT_FOUND
Approving an approved credit order again is 409 ALREADY_DECIDED
A credit order rejected by the rules cannot be approved (409 NOT_APPROVABLE)
Unknown credit decision is a 400 VALIDATION_ERROR
Credit orders can be listed per member (member 1 has five)
Audit: the blocked credit order wrote a credit_rule_check row
Audit: the farmer approval wrote a credit_approved row
Audit: the decline wrote a credit_declined row
Co-op: list harvest lots returns the three example lots
Lot 1 (HL-0042) is 2 400 kg from three members and nothing is allocated yet
Unknown lot gives 404 LOT_NOT_FOUND
Co-op: list contracts returns the five example contracts
Contract 1 is 2 000 kg of maize at R9.80 per kg, all still open
Allocating 2 400 kg to a 2 000 kg contract is rejected with LOT_EXCEEDS_CONTRACT and a suggested valid quantity of 2 000 kg
Boundary: allocating exactly the contract quantity (2 000 kg) is allowed
A pending allocation counts: one more kg to the same contract is rejected, suggested 0 kg
500 kg to contract 2 when only 400 kg of the lot is left is rejected with LOT_STOCK_EXCEEDED, suggested 400 kg
Boundary: allocating exactly the 400 kg left in the lot is allowed
A beans lot cannot be allocated to a maize contract (CROP_MISMATCH)
A closed contract cannot take an allocation (CONTRACT_CLOSED)
Allocation of 0 kg is a 400 VALIDATION_ERROR on kg
Allocation of 1.5 kg is a 400 VALIDATION_ERROR on kg (whole kg only)
Allocation from an unknown lot is 404 LOT_NOT_FOUND
Allocation to an unknown contract is 404 CONTRACT_NOT_FOUND
Audit: the blocked allocation wrote an allocation_rule_check row
Payout before anything is delivered is rejected (PAYOUT_NOT_DELIVERED)
Approving allocation 2 (2 000 kg to contract 1) is allowed
An approved but not yet delivered allocation does not allow a payout
A pending allocation cannot be marked delivered (409 NOT_DELIVERABLE)
Marking the approved allocation delivered works
Delivering twice is 409 ALREADY_DECIDED
Lot 1 now shows delivered 2 000 kg worth R19 600 split pro rata by contribution 1200/800/400 with the largest-remainder cent going to member 3 (9 800.00 + 6 533.33 + 3 266.67)
Default payout for member 1: gross = full share R9 800, the R5 000 open credit is deducted first, net R4 800
A second payout for the same share is rejected (PAYOUT_EXCEEDS_SHARE, suggested gross 0)
Default payout when the whole share is already committed is rejected (PAYOUT_NOTHING_DUE)
Gross R7 000 is above member 2 share R6 533.33: PAYOUT_EXCEEDS_SHARE with suggested gross R6 533.33
Member 3 has R1 000 open credit: paying out with no deduction is rejected (CREDIT_NOT_DEDUCTED, suggested R1 000)
Deducting R2 000 when only R1 000 credit is open is rejected (CREDIT_DEDUCTION_INVALID)
Default payout for member 3: gross R3 266.67, credit R1 000 deducted, net R2 266.67
A member who gave nothing to the lot gets MEMBER_NOT_IN_LOT
Negative gross is a 400 VALIDATION_ERROR on grossAmount
Payout for an unknown lot is 404 LOT_NOT_FOUND
Payout for an unknown member is 404 MEMBER_NOT_FOUND
Approving payout 3 re-runs the rules and approves it
Approving the payout repaid member 1 credit oldest first (R2 500, R1 350, then R1 150 of credit 5)
Member 1 now has no open credit and the full R5 000 available
Approving payout 9 (member 3) works
Member 3 credit of R1 000 is repaid
Approving payout 3 again is 409 ALREADY_DECIDED
A payout rejected by the rules cannot be approved (409 NOT_APPROVABLE)
Audit: the payout approval wrote a payout_approved row
Audit: the credit repayment wrote a credit_repaid_by_payout row
Approving allocation 5 (400 kg to contract 2) is allowed
Delivering allocation 5 raises the delivered lot value to R23 400
More delivered value raises the shares: member 2 default payout is now the full share R7 800
Fair allocation plan, enough stock: lot 2 (1 000 kg maize) vs 600 kg still open: contract 2 gets its 600 kg, 400 kg stay unallocated
Fair allocation plan, not enough stock: lot 3 (450 kg beans) vs contracts wanting 500 and 300: pro rata 281.25/168.75 gives 281 + 169 (largest remainder), total 450
Committing the plan creates two pending allocations through the same rules
Lot 3 is now fully allocated
A second plan for the same lot has nothing left to allocate
Contract 3 shows 281 kg allocated and 219 kg remaining
Audit: committing the plan wrote a fair_allocation_committed row
Fair allocation for an unknown lot is 404 LOT_NOT_FOUND
commit must be a boolean (400 VALIDATION_ERROR)
INTENTIONAL FAILURE: asserts that irrigating a wet plot is approved (the rules correctly reject it, so this case must fail)
